title: 12 Best Cycle through manicured rows of tea bushes in a British-era estate above Kandy and stop for freshly brewed single-origin Ceylon tea.
description: Explore Kandy's best tea estate cycling tours. Discover British-era plantations, pedal through lush tea fields, and savor single-origin Ceylon tea. Your ultimate guide to tea experiences.

places.name: Geragama Tea Plantation & Factory
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Factory Fresh Black Tea Tasting Session; Estate-grown Orange Pekoe (OP)

places.name: Loolkandura Estate (James Taylor's First Tea Estate)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A cup from the 'Taylor's First' tea series (if available) at the viewpoint

places.name: Helboda Tea Factory
places.priceRange: LKR 4,000-6,500 / $12-20 per person (tour + small cycling fee)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Dust and Fannings (D&F) - a strong, classic Ceylon brew often favored by locals.

places.name: Delta Tea Factory, Pussellawa
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Delta Green Tea; Broken Orange Pekoe Fannings (BOPF)

places.name: Hantana Tea Museum & Surrounding Estates
places.priceRange: LKR 3,500-7,000 / $10-22 per person (museum entry + guided cycling in adjacent estates)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any brew offered at the museum's tasting room, usually a classic high-grown Ceylon.

places.name: Kadugannawa Tea Factory & Estate
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Broken Orange Pekoe (BOP) from their shop.

places.name: Wattegama Tea Estate & Boutique Experience
places.priceRange: LKR 7,000-12,000 / $22-38 per person (curated tour + gourmet tea tasting + cycling)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Single-origin Wattegama Pekoe, paired with traditional Sri Lankan sweetmeats.

places.name: Storefield Tea Estate Tours (via Local Operators)
places.priceRange: LKR 6,000-9,500 / $18-30 per person (operator fee + estate access)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Whatever tea is being freshly brewed during your visit; ask for the estate's current best-selling grade.

places.name: Rukgala Retreat Tea Experience (on partner estate)
places.priceRange: LKR 8,000-15,000 / $25-45 per person (full experience, includes transfer & meal)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their signature organic Ceylon tea blend, perhaps infused with local herbs.

places.name: Mlesna Tea Centre & Estate View
places.priceRange: LKR 3,000-5,500 / $9-17 per person (sampling + light cycling in nearby public access roads)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of Mlesna's flavored teas or their specialty 'Silver Tips' white tea.

places.name: Thotulagala Estate (with prior arrangement)
places.priceRange: LKR 10,000-20,000 / $30-60 per person (private tour, includes refreshments)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Thotulagala Pekoe or any premium grade black tea freshly brewed.

places.name: Tea Leaf Vision Tea Estate (partnered tours)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their signature 'Empowerment Blend' or whatever tea is being processed, knowing your purchase supports a good cause.
